body:
spring.application.name: telemetry-ingestion-processing
spring.flyway.locations: classpath:db/migration
spring.r2dbc.url: ${R2DBC_URL:r2dbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/telemetry}
spring.r2dbc.username: ${R2DBC_USERNAME:telemetry}
spring.r2dbc.password: ${R2DBC_PASSWORD:telemetry}
telemetry.backfill.window-seconds: 60
telemetry.buffer.capacity: 1024
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include: health,metrics
logging.file.name: logs/telemetry-ingestion-processing.log
logging.structured.format.file: ecs
logging.logback.rollingpolicy.max-file-size: 10MB
logging.logback.rollingpolicy.max-history: 7
---
spring.config.activate.on-profile: test
spring.r2dbc.url: r2dbc:h2:mem:///telemetrydb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;NON_KEYWORDS=VALUE
spring.flyway.enabled: false
